items.title: 68097_Freddie Green oral history interview
items.q: if you listen to that record of Benny Moten's band in 1932 -- you've got Basie in there

ctx.x: I disagree with you a little bit there. I think you're overplaying that a little bit, because if you listen to that record of Benny Moten's band in 1932 -- you've got Basie in there, Walter Page, Lips Page and Ben Webster.
